name: Glassvow
subtitle: A pilgrimage in stained glass
promotionalText: A stained-glass pilgrimage. Walk the road. The Vigil remembers.
description:
Glassvow is a stained-glass pilgrimage.

A fire was cut into six pieces and scattered along the road. Walk east from the Vigil with a lantern. Gather what was broken. Light the rose. Open the sealed door at the far end.

It is also a roguelite deckbuilder. Build a deck of glass. Spend light. Shatter what blocks the way.

A complete premium game. No ads. Nothing else to buy after you start walking.
